title: FIRE-Drive: Feasibility-Informed Risk Evaluation for End-to-End Diffusion Planning
abstract: arXiv:2611.22297v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Diffusion-based end-to-end autonomous driving models have shown strong potential in generating multimodal planning trajectories. However, their performance still depends heavily on trajectory initialization, mode evaluation, and supervision quality. Weakly constrained noisy initialization may introduce infeasible proposals and increase the burden of denoising. Moreover, selecting the optimal mode remains challenging when candidate trajectories are geometrically similar but differ in safety, interaction risk, and progress. To address these issues, we propose FIRE-Drive, a feasibility-informed risk evaluation framework for end-to-end autonomous driving. FIRE-Drive improves diffusion-based planning through dynamic feasible anchor initialization, candidate-specific bird's-eye-view risk evidence, and compact high-quality candidate supervision with lightweight refinement. translated_title: FIRE-Drive：面向端到端扩散规划的可行性知情风险评估
translated_abstract: 基于扩散模型的端到端自动驾驶方法在生成多模态规划轨迹方面展现出强大潜力。然而，其性能仍在很大程度上依赖于轨迹初始化、模式评估和监督质量。约束薄弱的噪声初始化可能引入不可行的候选方案，并增加去噪负担。此外，当候选轨迹在几何上相似但在安全性、交互风险和进度方面存在差异时，选择最优模式仍然具有挑战性。为解决这些问题，我们提出了FIRE-Drive，一个面向端到端自动驾驶的可行性知情风险评估框架。FIRE-Drive通过动态可行锚点初始化、针对候选的鸟瞰图风险证据，以及结合轻量级精炼的紧凑高质量候选监督来改进基于扩散的规划。该设计使初始支撑、风险感知评分与多模态（轨迹生成）相统一……
tldr: 提出FIRE-Drive框架，通过动态可行锚点初始化、鸟瞰图风险证据和高质量紧凑候选监督，改进基于扩散模型的端到端自动驾驶规划中的可行性与风险评估。
en_tdlr: FIRE-Drive improves diffusion-based end-to-end autonomous driving planning through dynamic feasible anchor initialization, bird's-eye-view risk evidence, and compact high-quality candidate supervision.
